rounds.title: Bank Analytics Interview
rounds.description: Advanced risk, transaction-review and credit-governance interview practice using synthetic data.

questions.context: The interviewer asks for total synthetic outstanding exposure by risk band.
questions.prompt: Using loan_portfolio, return risk_band and total_outstanding.
questions.explanation: A strong answer aggregates at risk-band grain and does not confuse exposure with default probability.

questions.context: A monitoring rule flags a transaction for review.
options: The flag prioritizes review and should be validated against context and outcomes before customer action
Every large transaction should be blocked automatically
Review systems do not need false-positive monitoring
questions.expectedAnswer: The flag prioritizes review and should be validated against context and outcomes before customer action
questions.explanation: Signals and confirmed outcomes are different. Good operations analytics measures both detection value and false-positive cost.

questions.context: Portfolio delinquency rose this month and leadership asks whether credit quality is deteriorating.
questions.prompt: Describe how you would structure the analysis before recommending a policy change.
questions.explanation: A strong banking case separates portfolio-mix effects from true within-segment deterioration and validates data or policy changes before recommending action.
